description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the BlurFace operation for face de-identification
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸信息脱敏BlurFace的语法及示例
name: BlurFace

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the de-identified image.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To store the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
ImageURL.description_zh:
脱敏后的图片URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

MaskURL.description_en:
The mask URL of the de-identified image.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To store the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
